description: Search and recommend MCP servers by name, description, capabilities, protocol tools, company, task, and category. The query is optional; use filters or sort to browse the directory.

auth_type.description: Filter by the server authentication classification.

official.description: True for official servers, false for community servers. Unclassified servers are excluded.

query.description: Optional natural-language task, capability, server, company, or protocol-tool query.

sort.description: Sort explicitly instead of using relevance for a query or popularity for an empty query.

task.description: Primary task, secondary task, or MCP category slug.

transport.description: Filter by remote HTTP/SSE or local stdio transport.

name: search_mcps
title: Search MCPs
